reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is an instructional demonstration of using a Netflix gift card or redeem code for membership payment, consistent with the title, spoken explanation, and visible card instructions. The separate giveaway invitation, WowApp sign-up statement, and subscribe request are not described as requiring payment or data, promising earnings, or causing loss, and the subscribe request is not explicitly tied to the gift-card guidance or either promotion.

citations.quote: I'm Daikal, today I'm going to share about how to use this Netflix gift card or Netflix redeem code.
So if you want to use the netflix app for redeem, you go to the account section.
billing details your RM17. credit will be applied to your next billing.

opening.argument: Judge, the description does more than explain a payment method. It tells viewers to join a monthly giveaway at an external gift-card link. That pairs a prospective reward with an immediate action, while leaving the terms of the offer unstated. The tutorial may be genuine, but it does not establish what happens after a viewer follows that separate solicitation.

citations.quote: Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard
I'm Daikal, today I'm going to share about how to use this Netflix gift card or Netflix redeem code.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's gift-card explanation supports the tutorial portion, but it does not account for the giveaway invitation. Nor does the absence of an explicitly stated payment or data requirement settle the issue: the description sends viewers to an external destination without stating the offer's conditions.

citations.quote: Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The invitation establishes only that a giveaway link is offered. It does not show that entering requires payment, sensitive information, or any deceptive step. The spoken material instead explains gift-card redemption, and the account view shows a gift-card redemption option. Unstated giveaway terms are not evidence that the offer is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard
So if you want to use the netflix app for redeem, you go to the account section.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together: a monthly giveaway link, a separate invitation to sign up for a team to discuss making money with an app, and a gift-card-centered presentation. The sign-up is explicitly connected to the money-making pitch. None of these statements proves a loss occurred, but the combination makes the video a vehicle for soliciting participation in reward and income offers, not merely a neutral account walkthrough.

citations.quote: Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard
If you sign up here, you will be included in my WowApp Team where we will discuss and make money with this Wowapp app.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense says the promotions do not promise earnings, but the description expressly connects signing up with a team that will discuss and make money with the app. The billing demonstration cannot verify that separate income proposition or explain what participation entails.

citations.quote: If you sign up here, you will be included in my WowApp Team where we will discuss and make money with this Wowapp app.
billing details your RM17. credit will be applied to your next billing.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The WowApp sentence invites a sign-up and says the team will discuss making money; it gives no earnings figure, guaranteed return, or demonstrated deceptive condition. The gift card is shown as a way to pay for a Netflix membership, and the spoken explanation follows the redemption and billing workflow. Juxtaposing those facts does not establish a scam.

citations.quote: If you sign up here, you will be included in my WowApp Team where we will discuss and make money with this Wowapp app.
So if you want to use the netflix app for redeem, you go to the account section.

opening.argument: Judge, assess the video and description as one presentation. The speaker introduces a gift-card tutorial, while the description leads with a giveaway invitation and later asks viewers to join a money-making app team. The instructional walkthrough can make those adjacent solicitations seem relevant and credible, even though it demonstrates neither offer. Its educational content therefore also functions as a route toward reward- and income-related participation.

citations.quote: I'm Daikal, today I'm going to share about how to use this Netflix gift card or Netflix redeem code.
Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard
If you sign up here, you will be included in my WowApp Team where we will discuss and make money with this Wowapp app.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the account workflow as dispositive. But showing redemption and billing addresses how to use a gift card, not why the description directs viewers to a giveaway or a separate app sign-up. Those invitations remain part of the same presentation despite being outside the demonstrated workflow.

citations.quote: Join the Monthly Giveaway here: http://thehaikal.info/giftcard
If you sign up here, you will be included in my WowApp Team where we will discuss and make money with this Wowapp app.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The description contains separate promotions, but their presence does not turn the demonstrated redemption process into a deceptive offer. The speaker explains where to redeem a gift card and how remaining credit applies to billing; the account view is consistent with that explanation. Nothing cited shows that viewers must join either promotion to use the instructions, or that either invitation causes a loss.
